items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: He was in there. Dizzy was with Cab.

ctx.x: Cab. Cab had, he had some good musicians in the band. But, you know, with his '40 de-40 most of the features, Cab, you know, that he hired, you know, singing, like I said, they had Chu Berry (Unaudible) in there and, oh, Dizzy Gillespie. He was in there. Dizzy was with Cab. And, there are some names that can't come to me now. But, Cozy Cole. I think that was Cab's drummer, I believe. Then, he had Jonah Jones. He had some very good musicians in there. He had a good, he had a good playing band. He had a good band.…
Cab comes up here every now and then to do a show.
